title: In New Year's address to troops, Macron calls for more resources for the French army
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron, commander-in-chief of the armed forces, on Thursday outlined his “guidelines for national defence” at the strategic air base in Istres, Bouches-du-Rhône. His speech was highly anticipated as France continues to seek approval for its 2026 budget amid rising geopolitical tensions and growing military needs.
